Keep the furniture layout from the render, but make every object look real and high-end.
_global.coverings_rule: The window coverings are the subject of the photo and must be reproduced exactly as described (type, colour, how they hang, how open they are).
_global.style: Warm-minimal Scandinavian-meets-Québec style: natural oak, linen and boucle upholstery, wool and jute rugs, ceramic and stone accents, a few green plants, styled but not cluttered. Light: soft late-afternoon sun entering through the windows with gentle warm light patches on the floor, balanced exposure, windows not blown out. Through the glass: a quiet suburban street in Laval, Québec with two-storey houses and mature trees.
_global.camera: Full-frame camera, 20 mm lens, level camera with perfectly straight verticals, natural colours, realistic soft shadows and fine textures, ultra-detailed. No people, no text, no watermark, no logos.

g-salon.title: Living room
g-salon.scene: a bright living room with a light oak hardwood floor and warm white walls
g-salon.coverings: On the window: floor-to-ceiling ripple-fold curtains in oatmeal linen hanging from a slim white aluminium track mounted flush to the ceiling (no curtain rod, no rings, no finials, no pinch pleats), with even soft S-shaped waves running the full height from the ceiling down to one centimetre above the floor, drawn open and stacked neatly to each side of the window, plus a sheer white voile ripple-fold curtain on its own parallel ceiling track behind them, drawn closed across the glass so the view outside is softly diffused.
